seoTitle: Volume Converter: US and UK Gallons, Cups, Litres
metaDescription: Convert litres, cups, fluid ounces, pints and gallons with US and UK units kept apart. Exact factors, free, runs in your browser.
intro: Converts between litres, millilitres, cubic metres and US or UK (imperial) cups, fluid ounces, pints, quarts and gallons.
why:
A US gallon and a UK gallon are different sizes, 3.785 L against 4.546 L, and a UK pint holds 20 fluid ounces where a US pint holds 16. Mixing them up gives a 20 percent error in a recipe, a fuel figure or a pool.

This tool keeps the two systems in separate rows and uses the exact definitions, so you can see each equivalent at once. The general unit converter has only the US versions.
howTo: Pick the unit you start with.
Read all other units in the list.

faq.q: What is the difference between a US and a UK gallon?
faq.a: The US gallon is 231 cubic inches or 3.785 L. The UK imperial gallon is 4.54609 L, about 20 percent larger.
Here a US cup is 236.588 mL (one sixteenth of a gallon). Nutrition labels round it to 240 mL.

faq.q: Why are my results long decimals?
faq.a: Factors are exact, so results show up to ten significant digits. Round them for daily use.
